Default data_as_elements converts span and div with data-as

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
